description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's pack-object functionality with missing base objects. It sets up repositories, commits, and runs tests to verify behavior related to object packing and cloning in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed. Executes the provided commands and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes the specified lines to a file, used here to create 'text' and 'side' files.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Adds or updates index entries to prepare for commits.

methods.name: git commit-tree
methods.description: Creates a new commit object with specified parents and tree.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from the current index.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates a reference to point to a specific commit.

methods.name: git read-tree
methods.description: Reads a tree into the index.

methods.name: git cat-file
methods.description: Provides content or info about objects.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates a new object (blob, tree, commit) and returns its hash.

methods.name: git pull
methods.description: Fetches from and integrates with another repository or branch.

methods.name: git fetch
methods.description: Downloads objects and refs from another repository.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the executed command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
